title: Desk Guide: PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Tier After Arrears Payoff
content:
**Rule.** The day after a recovery tier's arrears balance reaches zero, the PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) account moves to its payoff tier, keeping its prepaid balance, its alert settings and its activation date. No other tier change is made on an open enrollment: a member whose situation fits a different tier (a new rate schedule, new arrears) must close or convert and enroll again. A tier change is never made while the account is disconnected for low balance.

**Payoff tiers**

| Tier | Payoff tier |
|---|---|
| PrePay Power Residential Recovery 25 | PrePay Power Residential |
| PrePay Power Residential Recovery 40 | PrePay Power Residential |
| PrePay Power Seasonal | PrePay Power Seasonal (no move) |
| PrePay Power Outbuilding | PrePay Power Outbuilding (no move) |
| PrePay Power Residential, PrePay Power Small Commercial | their own names (no move) |

**Cases (hypothetical dates)**

- A PrePay Power Residential Recovery 40 account's arrears balance reaches 0.00 on 12 June while the meter is on: on 13 June it moves to PrePay Power Residential with the same prepaid balance, alert amount, alert channel and activation date.
- A PrePay Power Residential account's member moves to a farm on Schedule FH with new arrears: the open enrollment's tier is not changed; the member closes or converts and enrolls again.
